scoped_positive_observations: Begin transfers connection ownership only after its complete checks and retains a kernel-pidfd-bound subject.
Revocation preserves the live subject pidfd and generation as a tombstone; poll errors do not count as process death.
A Suspended slot cannot reattach through another PID or a changed subject snapshot; the held caller task directory/birth lease is rechecked.

Suspend remains transport-dependent until explicit Detach, so an early HUP revokes. Correct acknowledgement-before-Detach ordering remains an owner event-loop obligation, not a fact proven by Registry alone.
AuthorizeCreate and FinishCreate retain/recheck the same caller directory and birth rather than reopening a numeric task path.
Descriptor reset preserves errno while closing known owned FDs; the shared-VM destructor issue is a separate ownership boundary.
